rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something varying irregularly, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: The market has been known to fluctuate lately, so doing business is really hard to predict.
example.traditional: 呢排個市道上上落落，做生意真係幾難捉摸。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 go3 si5 dou6 soeng6 soeng5 lok6 lok6 zou6 saang1 ji3 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 zuk1 mo2

rows.note: Use this mainly for prices, markets, rates, figures, or other measurable quantities in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The exchange rate is liable to fluctuate considerably this year.
example.traditional: 今年嘅匯率波動較大，出口商要小心管理風險。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ge3 wui6 leot2 bo1 dung6 gaau3 daai6 ceot1 hau2 soeng1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 gun2 lei5 fung1 him2

rows.traditional: 搞到 A 上上落落
rows.jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A soeng6 soeng5 lok6 lok6
rows.note: Use this casual causative construction when something makes A vary irregularly.

example.english: The changing petrol prices cause our household expenses to fluctuate.
example.traditional: 油價成日變，搞到我哋屋企嘅開支上上落落。
example.jyutping: jau4 gaa3 seng4 jat6 bin3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 hoi1 zi1 soeng5 soeng5 lok6 lok6
